source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 4: tree, P and Q 30 m apart, angles of elevation 12 and 15 degrees; height of the tree. Answer key PDF 309.

blocks.prompt: 4 \(P\) and \(Q\) are two points in line with a tree. If the distance between \(P\) and \(Q\) be 30 m and the angles of elevation of the top of the tree at \(P\) and \(Q\) be \(12^{\circ}\) and \(15^{\circ}\) respectively, find the height of the tree.
blocks.explanation:
Do jagah se ek hi darakht ki choti dekhi gayi hai; unchai bhi maloom nahi aur darakht se faasla bhi nahi.
Humein unchai \(h\) chahiye.
Plan: \(\cot\) se faasla \(x\) do tarah likhna, minus kar ke \(x\) ko khatam karna, phir \(h\) nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(PQ = 30\) m; choti T ka angle of elevation P se \(12^{\circ}\) aur Q se \(15^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: darakht ki unchai \(h = BT\).
Tareeqa: \(BQ = x\) maan lein. Har right triangle mein \(\text{base} = h\cot(\text{angle})\). Do unknowns (\(h\) aur \(x\)) aur do equations; minus karne se \(x\) ghayab ho jata hai. Yeh "do observation points" wale har sawal ka pakka tareeqa hai.

Kaunsa point qareeb hai?
Kyun: Jab aap kisi cheez ke qareeb hote hain to choti dekhne ke liye sir zyada upar uthana parta hai. Is liye bara angle (\(15^{\circ}\)) qareeb wale point Q ka hai, aur P us se 30 m peeche hai: \(BP = x + 30\).
Dhyan dein: Agar P ko qareeb maan liya to \(h\) negative aayega; yeh ishara hai ke figure ulti hai.

Q wali equation
\[\tan 15^{\circ} = \dfrac{h}{x}\]
\[x = h\cot 15^{\circ} \quad (1)\]
Kyun: Right triangle BQT mein perpendicular \(h\) (darakht) aur base \(x\) hai. \(\tan = \frac{\text{perpendicular}}{\text{base}}\); is se \(x\) ko \(h\) ki shakal mein likh liya.

P wali equation
\[\tan 12^{\circ} = \dfrac{h}{x + 30}\]
\[x + 30 = h\cot 12^{\circ} \quad (2)\]
Kyun: Triangle BPT mein perpendicular wohi \(h\) hai lekin base ab \(x + 30\) hai, kyunke P, Q se 30 m aur door hai.

(2) mein se (1) minus karein
\[30 = h(\cot 12^{\circ} - \cot 15^{\circ})\]
\[h = \dfrac{30}{\cot 12^{\circ} - \cot 15^{\circ}}\]
Kyun: Left side par \((x + 30) - x = 30\) bacha aur right side par \(h\) common nikla. Ab sirf ek unknown \(h\) hai; dono taraf bracket se divide kar diya.

Values rakhein
\[h = \dfrac{30}{4.7046 - 3.7321}\]
\[= \dfrac{30}{0.9725} \approx 30.85 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: \(\cot 12^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\tan 12^{\circ}} \approx 4.7046\) aur \(\cot 15^{\circ} \approx 3.7321\). Calculator mein cot ka button nahi hota, is liye \(1 \div \tan\) karein.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 30.85 \times 3.7321 \approx 115.12\]
\[\tan 12^{\circ} \times 145.12 \approx 30.85 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Equation (1) se \(x\) nikala, phir P wale triangle se unchai dobara nikali: wohi 30.85 m aayi. Dono triangles ek hi jawab dete hain, is liye hisaab sahi hai.

blocks.text: Answer key mein height \(= 30.92\) m chhapi hai. Sahi value \(\frac{30}{\cot 12^{\circ} - \cot 15^{\circ}} = 30.85\) m hai; chaar hindson wali tables se taqreeban 30.90 m aata hai. Key ka 30.92 m zyada round ki hui values ka nateeja hai; sahi unchai 30.85 m hai.
